# YOKO! Student

> A free money planner web app for students, made by YOKOMONEY. It tracks pocket money and part-time income, shows a daily "safe to spend" amount, splits bills with roommates, and helps students save for goals. It works offline and keeps data on the device; optional sync is end-to-end encrypted.

## What it does
- Safe to spend today: one daily number based on allowance, bills still due and spending so far
- Run-out forecast: whether the money lasts until the next allowance
- Semester plan: sets money aside for fees, exams and trips
- Spending log, budget categories, recurring payments and a subscription catcher
- Split bills and IOUs with roommates, with UPI pay links and QR codes (India)
- Savings goals, wishlist, challenges and a money pet that levels up
- Paste a bank SMS or statement, or scan a receipt (read on the device) to log spends
- An AI command bar for logging spends and asking "can I afford this?"
